Verses.Text: The LORD gave and the LORD has taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD!
I know that my vindicator lives, and that he will at last stand forth upon the dust.
The LORD addressed Job out of the storm and said:
Where were you when I founded the earth? Tell me, if you have understanding.
By hearsay I had heard of you, but now my eye has seen you.
The LORD restored the fortunes of Job, when he prayed for his friends; the LORD even gave to Job twice as much as he had before.
